title: Orchestration (Capability-Aware, Compact Handoffs)
content:
Orchestration (Capability-Aware, Compact Handoffs) Nautilus uses compact handoff packets for internal orchestration ( src/lib/control-plane/orchestration.ts ). Implemented now: Schema-validated AgentHandoffState with explicit phase, privacy, token budget, and degraded reason fields. Deterministic handoff compaction with evidence reference preservation. Explicit local-only fail-closed routing behavior. Truth statement
Nautilus implements capability-aware orchestration hooks and compact recursive handoffs. It does not claim true hidden-state RecursiveMAS transfer, TurboQuant, KIVI, speculative decoding, or backend-native acceleration unless the selected serving backend exposes and confirms those capabilities
summary: Nautilus uses compact handoff packets for internal orchestration (src/lib/control-plane/orchestration.ts).
